- Email marketing involves sending commercial messages to a group of people via email. It can be used to promote products/services, deliver newsletters, announce sales, etc.

- Benefits include low cost, easy tracking, high open rates compared to other channels, and ability to segment and target audiences. 

- Important tactics include building a quality email list, personalizing messages, using attention-grabbing subject lines, testing different approaches, automating campaigns, and analyzing results.

- Key metrics to track are open rate, clickthrough rate, unsubscribe rate, and conversion rate. Aim for open rates above 20%.

- CAN-SPAM Act and GDPR establish rules for proper consent, content, and unsubscribing. Honor opt-out requests immediately.

- Significant ongoing optimization is required to achieve best results in inbox placement, deliverability, relevance, and engagement.
